flags.text:
The best team players were Mady, Kristina and Kyler. Landen and Gabe needed to wear more hats: 
- Near the beginning of the shift, I noticed that there was an order that came in thru the drive thru with two large drinks and one of them was discounted under ‘employee discount’. I saw that it said Landen took the order so I asked him and he confirmed he took the order. I asked why he put that and he said that he meant to click Birthday drink. I told him that we still can’t do a birthday drink for a large or an adult and he said he asked the guy for his ID and that he didn’t have the app. I told him that we still can’t do that which I would think he would know… and I also asked him if he knew the person and he said no. This just seemed off to me because I have seen previously that he has used his discount for friends/family in the drive thru and other leads have reported this and so it seemed to me that this was a situation of that happening again and I think it’s unfair for him to be abusing his discount in this way. I told Noelle about this during the shift since she was there also. 
- Gabe was scheduled to shut down machine 3 from 6-6:45pm. At around 6:47/6:50 I saw him clock out and walk out the door without saying anything. The bar still had sauce bottles not filled, the grind bin not with a new bag, the drain dirty, syrups not stocked, etc. he then came back in a couple minutes later and continued working on the bar. I asked him if he had clocked out and he said yes so I said he’s not allowed to keep working off the clock to which he said “yes that’s true”. I then asked him if there was a specific reason it took so long to shut down the bar. The reason I asked this was because it was machine 3, which has much less things on it to have to do when shutting down. It also was already softly shut down earlier in the day. I don’t feel like there was any reason he should have taken almost an hour and still not have so many things done. I also thought it was weird to clock out and continue, and that he should have just told me he didn’t finish in time or just finished up the last things since he already had gone over the 45 minutes. He then said “it was pretty hard to work around all of the boxes”. He is referring to a bunch of small, empty boxes that I had put on the floor while doing the food thaw. This makes no sense considering this was empty boxes that he easily could have pushed away, asked me to move, etc. they also were not in the way of the sink and he was doing dishes almost the entire shut down time. This felt like a way to try to blame it on me or have some type of attitude which I have experienced from him before. I also had broken down and gotten rid of the boxes about 20 minutes into him shutting down which I explained to him. I told him he can’t work off the clock and I would finish the tasks for him and then he left.
Good
